title: Business settings
description: Your company details. They are printed on every invoice.
saved: Settings saved. New invoices will use these details.

business.title: Your business
business.hint: Name and address shown at the top of invoices.
business.name: Business name
business.legalNameHint: Only if it is different from the business name, e.g. "Shree Ganesh Bricks Pvt Ltd".

gst.title: GST
gst.hint: Only needed if your business is registered for GST.
gst.question: Is your business registered for GST?
gst.gstinHint: 15 characters, as on your GST certificate.
gst.hsnHint: Fly ash bricks are usually 6815. Ask your accountant if unsure.
gst.noGstNote: Invoices will be made without GST.

payment.title: How customers pay you
payment.hint: Printed at the bottom of invoices so customers can pay easily.
payment.upiHint: Customers can pay to this from any UPI app.

invoice.terms: Note at the bottom of invoices
invoice.termsHint: For example: "Goods once sold will not be taken back."
invoice.prefixHint: Invoices are numbered like INV/2026-27/0001 and restart every April.
